Using a cofactor expansion along the $4$th column, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 4 & 0 \\ 3 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ -1 & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ -3 & -2 & 5 & -1\end{aligned}| & =0\cdot {C}_{14}+2\cdot {C}_{24}+0\cdot {C}_{34}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{44} \\  & =2\cdot (-1)^{2+4}\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 4 \\ -1 & 2 & 3 \\ -3 & -2 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{4+4}\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 4 \\ 3 & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 4 \\ -1 & 2 & 3 \\ -3 & -2 & 5\end{aligned}|-|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 4 \\ 3 & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
